title: Missing SafeERC20 causes permanent revert for USDT and non-bool-returning tokens
description: The codebase uses raw IERC20 interface calls without SafeERC20. USDT (which returns void instead of bool) causes ABI decode revert, making any dispatcher registered with USDT permanently non-functional. Also affects BalancerPooler lines 79,85 and Gather line 60.
